attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Iowa corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.ia_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ia_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus - filing required (no transaction count as of 7/1/2023)

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Iowa state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. IA requires addback of state taxes deducted federally and allows subtraction of federal interest income.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Iowa state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set ia_result.state_additions = 0.0; if ia_result.state_taxes_deducted != 0.0 then set ia_result.state_additions = ia_result.state_additions + ia_result.state_taxes_deducted; endif set ia_result.state_subtractions = 0.0; if ia_result.us_interest_income != 0.0 then set ia_result.state_subtractions = ia_result.state_subtractions + ia_result.us_interest_income; endif if ia_result.municipal_interest != 0.0 then set ia_result.state_subtractions = ia_result.state_subtractions + ia_result.municipal_interest; endif add (("Iowa additions: $" + string value of (ia_result.state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (ia_result.state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /ia_result.state_additions xdef { ia_result.state_additions ia_result.state_taxes_deducted f+ cvd /ia_result.state_additions xdef } {} ia_result.state_taxes_deducted 0.0 f!= ifelse 0.0 cvd /ia_result.state_subtractions xdef { ia_result.state_subtractions ia_result.us_interest_income f+ cvd /ia_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ia_result.us_interest_income 0.0 f!= ifelse { ia_result.state_subtractions ia_result.municipal_interest f+ cvd /ia_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ia_result.municipal_interest 0.0 f!= ifelse "Iowa additions: $" ia_result.state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat ia_result.state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Iowa corporate income tax. Applies Iowa graduated rates (5.5% on first $100K, 7.1% over $100K) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ia_apportioned_income is greater than 0
Income exceeds $100,000 bracket threshold; result.ia_taxable_income is greater than result.ia_tax_bracket_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Iowa tax with graduated rates - income over $100K; Apply graduated rates: 5.5% on first $100K, 7.1% on excess
action_details.action_dsl: set ia_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (ia_result.apportioned_income + ia_result.state_additions - ia_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set ia_result.tax_bracket_1 = ia_result.tax_bracket_threshold * ia_result.corp_tax_rate_bracket_1; set ia_result.tax_bracket_2 = (ia_result.taxable_income - ia_result.tax_bracket_threshold) * ia_result.corp_tax_rate_bracket_2; set ia_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (ia_result.tax_bracket_1 + ia_result.tax_bracket_2 - ia_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set ia_result.refund_or_owed = ia_result.estimated_payments - ia_result.tax_liability; add "Iowa taxable income: $" + string value of (ia_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Iowa tax bracket 1 (5.5% on $100K): $" + string value of (ia_result.tax_bracket_1) to job.audit_trail; add "Iowa tax bracket 2 (7.1% on excess): $" + string value of (ia_result.tax_bracket_2) to job.audit_trail; add "Iowa tax liability: $" + string value of (ia_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: ia_result.apportioned_income ia_result.state_additions f+ ia_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ia_result.taxable_income xdef ia_result.tax_bracket_threshold ia_result.corp_tax_rate_bracket_1 fmul cvd /ia_result.tax_bracket_1 xdef ia_result.taxable_income ia_result.tax_bracket_threshold f- ia_result.corp_tax_rate_bracket_2 fmul cvd /ia_result.tax_bracket_2 xdef ia_result.tax_bracket_1 ia_result.tax_bracket_2 f+ ia_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ia_result.tax_liability xdef ia_result.estimated_payments ia_result.tax_liability f- cvd /ia_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Iowa taxable income: $" ia_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Iowa tax bracket 1 (5.5% on $100K): $" ia_result.tax_bracket_1 cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Iowa tax bracket 2 (7.1% on excess): $" ia_result.tax_bracket_2 cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Iowa tax liability: $" ia_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Iowa tax - income $100K or less (only 5.5% rate); Apply only 5.5% rate for income under $100K
action_details.action_dsl: set ia_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (ia_result.apportioned_income + ia_result.state_additions - ia_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set ia_result.tax_bracket_1 = ia_result.taxable_income * ia_result.corp_tax_rate_bracket_1; set ia_result.tax_bracket_2 = 0.0; set ia_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (ia_result.tax_bracket_1 - ia_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set ia_result.refund_or_owed = ia_result.estimated_payments - ia_result.tax_liability; add "Iowa taxable income: $" + string value of (ia_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Iowa tax liability (5.5%): $" + string value of (ia_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: ia_result.apportioned_income ia_result.state_additions f+ ia_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ia_result.taxable_income xdef ia_result.taxable_income ia_result.corp_tax_rate_bracket_1 fmul cvd /ia_result.tax_bracket_1 xdef 0.0 cvd /ia_result.tax_bracket_2 xdef ia_result.tax_bracket_1 ia_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ia_result.tax_liability xdef ia_result.estimated_payments ia_result.tax_liability f- cvd /ia_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Iowa taxable income: $" ia_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Iowa tax liability (5.5%): $" ia_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
